patch_description: Apply a short Savitzky-Golay smoothing pass to the RTS-smoothed slope state (which is already heavily denoised, unlike prior failed lead attempts on noisy slopes), then add a small conservative slope-lead to the output level. This attacks lag error without amplifying noise-induced reversals: the lead is a fraction (0.2) of the smoothed slope scaled by the effective delay (window_size//2), and because the slope channel is SG-smoothed first, the injected lead is nearly noise-free, so false reversals should not increase.
